sections.content: Workplace problems can be explained by linking a cause to a consequence. Porque, debido a, por eso, por lo tanto and así que show why something happened and what followed.

items.spanish: Hubo un retraso porque faltaban unos documentos.
items.english: There was a delay because some documents were missing.

items.spanish: Debido a un error en el informe, tuvimos que repetir el análisis.
items.english: Because of an error in the report, we had to repeat the analysis.

items.spanish: El plazo era muy corto, por eso tuvimos que trabajar más rápido.
items.english: The deadline was very short, so we had to work faster.

items.spanish: El equipo encontró una solución, así que pudimos terminar el proyecto.
items.english: The team found a solution, so we were able to finish the project.

sections.content: A clear professional explanation identifies the cause and then the consequence.
